_rule: values within 2e-5 for lossless files; for MP3, Vorbis and AAC within lossy_bound, measured and proposed by B-518, clicks exact either way; length from shortest to samples; places past the length read are not compared. A raw AAC stream (.aac) carries no record of its encoder's start delay, so it is read 1,024 samples late, as ffmpeg reads it: a gap of the format, not of the reader
